title: 第3章 三小只第4章 吃个梨吧
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
花乾心甘情愿又愉快无比地当上了守灵门的掌门，虽然不知道门派欠了多少债务，但瘦死的龙比蛟大，大不了她也能悄悄跑掉。
师父都能把掌门令扔在门派内，自己肯定也行，八成是没找对正确的方法，所以被打了。
不过掌门令在师父手上时，难道没给他好处，何必出去借这么多债，求一求令哥不就行了？
但想想自己才拿到手，下一秒就被打成粉碎性骨折，师父长的又没自己这么可爱漂亮，保养的又不好，就是个老头而已，掌门令不搭理他也是有可能的。
她摇摇头，算了。
反正不急，慢慢来好了。
现在首先要做的，就是去自己的新洞府看一看，帮师父把他老人家不要的垃圾回收一下。
刚刚的可怕经历让人又渴又累，摘两个种在自己院子里的灵梨吃吃，这也是可以理解的啦。
花乾的做人理念便是，做人嘛，最重要的就是开心。
跑不了还有好处，那当掌门也不算坏，反正债主闯不进来，门派里也没其它人夺权。
整个门派的资源都是自己的，这种好事一般人可遇不到，灭门惨事那可是会被抢得寸草不留，哪像现在什么都在。
“走嘞，吃梨去。”花乾美滋滋地走出敬祖殿，正要去接管师父的洞府，突然就发现不知什么时候，广场上站了两男一女三个小孩。
他们穿着门服，最大的男孩看起来十一二岁，小小年纪就透出股少年老成的气息，紧抿着嘴警惕地看着她。
女孩要小一些，差不多九岁左右，长得很可爱，眼睛贼溜溜地好像有很多鬼点子，一看就是个棘手的小孩。
最小的男孩只有六七岁，长得虎头虎脑，手里拿着一根树枝，正摆出一副要接招的架势，看起来脑子不太好。
花乾与他们大眼对小眼地瞪着，心头大感不好，试探地问道：“你们爹娘是门中弟子？”
女孩噗嗤地就笑出了声，叉着腰一点也不客气地说道：“你是花三十二师姐吧？”
“我们是掌门师父在你出去游历时收的弟子，这是三十三师兄萧时乐，我是排行三十四的冷魔艳，那个傻子是三十五小师弟元宝。”
花乾愣怔地看着她，这小孩好跩好讨厌，忍不住说道：“你这名字可真够像个魔头的。”
冷魔艳立马变了脸，一跺脚气呼呼地说道：“你怎么回事，不赶快问我们门派出了什么事，却只注意我的名字。”

“还以为来了个能做主的人，却没想到却是个没用的。”
花乾啧啧了一声，指着萧时乐说：“萧师弟你来说。”
看这三位师弟师妹那刚刚炼气初期的修为，她就知道肯定是师父嫌他们没用，给扔在了门派里没带出去，这才逃过了一劫。
还以为整个门派就只剩下了自己，现在却多了三个拖油瓶，日子怕是不好过了。
这边被点名的萧时乐还没说话，元宝却跳了出来，手拿树枝就是一阵乱挥，“妖女，吃本大侠一招。”
好讨厌小孩啊！
花乾从乾坤袋中掏出一堆东西，朝他扔了过去，“一边玩去，别烦我。”
一把木剑、布老虎、点心等从凡人城镇买来的东西，掉在了元宝的身上。
“宝剑！”元宝瞬间扔掉手中的树枝，捡起木剑兴奋地喊道，然后在旁边开始耍起乱七八糟的剑式来。
花乾瞅了他一眼，赞赏道：“这是个剑痴啊，好一个剑修苗子，此子未来必有一番惊天作为。”
“师姐，师父说小师弟天生巨力，没有半点剑修天赋，是天生的体修之材。”萧时乐沉不住气了，拱手说道。
冷魔艳嘟哝道：“笨蛋，真没眼力。”
花乾看了三人一眼，把掌门令掏了出来，带着一丝得意在三人面前晃了一圈，“从现在开始，我就是守灵门的掌门了，不要叫我师姐，要叫我掌门大人。”
“现在山门外站满了愤怒的债主，做人不要太从心，不然我把你拿给他们抵债。”这话她是特意说给冷魔艳听的。
每个门派的小师妹因为年龄小的原因，都会很受宠，这个抢了花乾小师妹位置的女孩，她觉得一点也没自己可爱。
“……”冷魔艳无语地看着她，只觉得这个师姐幼稚到了极点，竟然还威胁起小孩来了。
听到要拿他们抵债，元宝赶快跑了回来，手贴在大腿边，站得直直的说：“我听话，师姐你不要把我卖了。”
萧时乐在心中重重叹了口气，说道：“掌门师姐，我们先说正事吧。”
花乾眼睛一亮，果然还是有机灵的师弟，“好，你慢慢说。”
content_en:
Hua Gan became the head of the Soul Watching Sect willingly and happily. Although she didn't know how much debt the sect owed, the skinny dragon was bigger than the dragon, so she could run away quietly at worst.
If the master can throw the leader's order into the sect, he can definitely do it too. Most likely, he didn't find the right method, so he was beaten.
But when the master's order is in the hands of the master, doesn't it give him any benefits? Why go out and borrow so many debts, just ask Brother Ling?
But thinking about it, I just got it, and the next second it was shattered into comminuted fractures. The master is not as cute and beautiful as me, and he is not well maintained. He is just an old man. It is possible that the leader will ignore him.
She shook her head, forget it.
Anyway, there's no rush, just take your time.
The first thing to do now is to take a look at his new cave and help Master recycle the old man’s unwanted garbage.
The terrible experience just now made me thirsty and tired, so it was understandable that I picked two spiritual pears planted in my yard and ate them.
Huagan's philosophy of life is that the most important thing in life is to be happy.
There are advantages to not being able to run away, so being the leader is not a bad thing. Creditors can't break in anyway, and no one else in the sect can seize power.
The resources of the entire sect are their own. This kind of good thing is not something that ordinary people can encounter. If the family is wiped out, not a single blade of grass will be left. It's not like everything is there now.
"Let's go and eat some pears." Hua Gan happily walked out of the Ancestor Respecting Hall and was about to take over the master's cave when he suddenly discovered that two men, one woman and three children were standing in the square at some unknown time.
They were wearing door uniforms. The oldest boy looked to be eleven or twelve years old. He exuded a youthful and mature air at a young age. He pursed his lips and looked at her warily.
The girl is younger, about nine years old, very cute, with sneaky eyes that seem to have a lot of tricks up her sleeve. At first glance, she is a troublesome child.
The youngest boy was only six or seven years old, with a thick head and a thick head. He was holding a branch in his hand, and he was posing as if he was about to receive a move. He looked like he was not very well-informed.
Huagan stared at them with big eyes and small eyes. Feeling bad, he asked tentatively: "Are your parents disciples?"
The girl laughed out loud, put her hands on her hips and said without politeness: "Are you Senior Sister Hua 32nd?"
"We are the disciples that the head master took in when you were traveling. This is the thirty-third senior brother Xiao Shile. I am the thirty-fourth ranked Leng Moyan. That fool is the thirty-fifth junior brother Yuan Bao."
Hua Gan looked at her blankly. This child was so weird and annoying. He couldn't help but said, "Your name really sounds like a devil."
Leng Moyan immediately changed her face, stamped her foot and said angrily: "What's the matter with you? You didn't quickly ask what happened to our sect, but you only paid attention to my name."
"I thought there was someone who could make the decision, but I didn't expect that he was useless."
Huagan clicked his tongue, pointed at Xiao Shile and said, "Junior Brother Xiao, tell me."
Looking at the cultivation of these three junior brothers and sisters who were just in the early stage of Qi refining, she knew that the master must have thought they were useless and had thrown them into the sect without taking them out, so they escaped.
I thought that I was the only one left in the entire sect, but now there are three more troublemakers, and life may be difficult.
Xiao Shile, who was named here, hadn't spoken yet, but Yuan Bao jumped out and waved the branch in his hand, "Witch, take advantage of this hero's move."
I hate children so much!
Huagan took out a bunch of things from the Qiankun bag and threw them at him, "Go and play, don't bother me."
A wooden sword, cloth tiger, snacks and other things bought from a mortal town fell on Yuan Bao's body.
"Sword!" Yuan Bao instantly threw away the branch in his hand, picked up the wooden sword and shouted excitedly, and then started to play messy sword moves next to him.
Hua Gan glanced at him and said appreciatively: "This is a swordsman. What a young swordsman. This boy will definitely do something shocking in the future.". "
"Senior sister, Master said that my junior brother is born with great strength and does not have any talent for swordsmanship. He is a natural talent for physical training. "Xiao Shile couldn't hold back his anger and said with cupped hands.
Leng Moyan muttered: "Idiot, you really have no eyesight. "
Huagan glanced at the three of them, took out the leader's order, and waved it in front of the three of them with a hint of pride, "From now on, I am the leader of the Soul Guarding Sect. Don't call me senior sister, call me the leader." "
"There are angry creditors standing outside the mountain gate now. Don't take yourself too seriously, or I will give you to them to pay off your debts. "She said this specifically to Leng Moyan.
Junior sisters of every sect are favored because of their young age. She feels that this girl who has usurped the position of junior junior sister Hua Gan is not as cute as herself at all.
"..." Leng Moyan looked at her speechlessly, feeling that this senior sister was extremely childish and even threatened the child.
When he heard that they were going to pay off the debt, Yuanbao ran back quickly, put his hand on his thigh, stood up straight and said: "I am obedient, senior sister, please don't sell me. "
Xiao Shile sighed heavily in his heart and said, "Senior Sister, let's get down to business first. "
Huagan's eyes lit up, and he was indeed a clever junior brother, "Okay, please speak slowly. "
